text:
Mira (AE): Hey team — ACME Health asked for IAM/access-control evidence as part of their vendor risk review (SIG-lite + a few follow-ups). They want: SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement proof, RBAC matrix, service account list + rotation policy. POC kickoff targeted next Mon, they want artifacts by Thu. @Sam can you confirm POC pricing/terms?

Sam (Solutions): I can put together a POC pricing note today. For artifacts we can share: SAML metadata XML (safe), screenshots of IdP conditional policies, RBAC CSV (anonymized), and a redacted audit export showing MFA events. Need Security sign-off on redactions.

Raj (Security): Ok. Quick constraints: we cannot share raw logs with user emails. We'll provide sanitized logs (replace email -> userX@example.com) and screenshots of policy pages. For MFA "proof" we usually include: 1) IdP conditional access screenshot, 2) a short query of the auth logs showing events where auth_method=mfa (redacted), 3) statement of enforcement (policy GUID). Also add service-account rotation evidence (KMS key rotation or commit history). I can prep examples by Wed.

Olivia (Sales Eng): I'll assemble the RBAC matrix and least-privilege notes. For RBAC CSV I'll include columns: role, scope, permissions, example resources, assigned_count. I can produce a trimmed version for external sharing. ETA Wed EOD.

infra-bot: New doc created: /internal/presales/ACME/iam-evidence-pkg-draft-v1.pdf (private link) :file_folder:

Mira (AE): Thanks. Action items: Sam — pricing by EOD today; Raj — MFA & redacted logs by Wed; Olivia — RBAC CSV by Wed; I'll promise delivery to customer by Thu COB. Also need to confirm whether NDAs/contract language allow us to share redacted logs — @Raj any blockers?

Sam (Solutions): Pricing note sent to Mira via DM. Proposal: 3-month Dedicated POC at a negotiated daily rate with an overage cap, or short-term reserved capacity at a reduced commit for POC. Recommend disabling autoscale burst for cost control.

Raj (Security): No legal blocker if logs are redacted. We need legal review only if they request raw audit data. We'll include a short attestation line: "Logs have been sanitized to remove PII per our data-sharing policy."

Olivia (Sales Eng): Uploading RBAC CSV to the presales folder now — link (internal): https://drive.internal/redwood/presales/ACME/rbac-csv-v1.csv :link: Sample line in case it helps: ```role,scope,permissions,example_resource,assigned_count\nread_only,project,read,project/health-data,12```

Raj (Security): For the SIG/CAIQ responses, include these IAM control items in our answers: SSO (SAML), MFA enforcement, adaptive auth, least-privilege RBAC, periodic access reviews, service account lifecycle, and audit log retention. Mark controls that depend on customer-managed IdP as "customer_configured".

Mira (AE): Great. I'll draft the customer message to say: we can deliver a redacted evidence package (SAML metadata, MFA screenshots + sanitized logs, RBAC matrix, rotation proof) by Thu COB, and share pricing for the POC now. Any objections? :thumbsup:

Sam (Solutions): +1. One more operational note — when we export audit logs for redaction, use this command (example):
```
# export auth logs last 30 days
api-client export-logs --service auth --since 30d --format jsonl > acme_auth_30d.jsonl
# then run sanitizer
python tools/sanitize_logs.py --input acme_auth_30d.jsonl --redact-emails --output acme_auth_30d_sanitized.jsonl
```

Raj (Security): Good. Use the sanitizer and run a quick checksum diff to ensure no emails remain. I'll review the sanitized file before we send.

Olivia (Sales Eng): Confirmed upload: https://drive.internal/redwood/presales/ACME/rbac-csv-v1.csv (shared with Mira, Raj).

Mira (AE): Perfect — I'll update the prospect: deliverables timeline + pricing. Raj/Olivia/Sam, thanks for the fast turnaround. I'll post the final zip here when ready and link the external package.

Sam (Solutions): Sent pricing DM to Mira.

Raj (Security): I'll drop the sanitized MFA log samples into the presales folder by Wed morning.

Olivia (Sales Eng): If they ask for role separation examples, I have a short doc (least-privilege patterns) I'll attach.

Mira (AE): Awesome. Closing this thread for now — will reopen if ACME requests raw logs or additional evidence. :white_check_mark:
